business_meaning: Customer ID in the CRM system
notes: Primary key; never null; assigned when the customer is created

business_meaning: Revenue collected from the customer for the transaction
related_kpi: Monthly revenue; average transaction value; customer lifetime value
notes: USD; maps to transaction_amount in the current sample; investigate nulls and negative values

description: Date and time when a transaction occurred
notes: UTC timezone; maps to transaction_date in the current sample; never null for completed transactions

business_meaning: Business segment used for pricing and go-to-market decisions
related_kpi: Segment revenue; segment profitability; segment churn rate
notes: Valid values are B2B, B2C, and SMB; updated monthly from CRM; null values become UNKNOWN

description: Binary indicator of churn within 90 days
business_meaning: Whether the customer left within 90 days of the reference transaction
notes: Valid values are 0 and 1; target variable for retention models; document the observation window with each model version
